result.summary: Mostly made of stainless steel body with plastic handle and internal heating element.

parts.name: Stainless steel body
parts.process_detail: Sheet steel is pressed into cylindrical shape using progressive dies and then welded.
parts.fun_fact: Deep drawn kettles require multiple drawing stages to achieve the depth without tearing the metal.

parts.name: Plastic handle
parts.process_detail: Molten plastic injected into mould cavity to form ergonomic handle shape with grip.
parts.fun_fact: Kettle handles use heat resistant plastics that can withstand over 120 degrees Celsius continuously.

parts.name: Lid assembly
parts.process_detail: Flat steel sheet stamped into domed lid shape with button mechanism assembled.
parts.fun_fact: Kettle lids often have steam vents positioned to direct hot steam away from the handle.

parts.name: Water level window
parts.process_detail: Clear plastic moulded and sealed into body opening with gasket for water tightness.
parts.fun_fact: Polycarbonate windows can withstand boiling water contact and are more impact resistant than glass.

parts.name: Base ring
parts.process_detail: Ring stamped from sheet metal and attached to body to protect base.
parts.fun_fact: The base ring provides stability and protects countertops from heat transfer during operation.

parts.name: Heating element
parts.process_detail: Nichrome wire encased in steel tube with magnesium oxide insulation, sealed and mounted.
parts.fun_fact: Concealed heating elements heat water faster than exposed coils and prevent mineral buildup on the element.

parts.name: Spout
parts.process_detail: Formed from sheet steel and welded to body with precise angle for drip free pouring.
parts.fun_fact: Spout geometry is carefully designed to create laminar flow and prevent dribbling when pouring.

parts.name: Control PCB
parts.process_detail: Components soldered onto board to control heating element and auto shutoff function.
parts.fun_fact: Modern kettle PCBs include thermistors that detect steam temperature to trigger automatic shutoff at boiling.

journey.title: Steel coil production
journey.detail: Iron ore smelted and rolled into thin stainless steel coils at steel mill.

journey.title: Body forming
journey.detail: Steel sheets deep drawn into kettle body and spout, then welded together.

journey.title: Component manufacturing
journey.detail: Handle and lid moulded from plastic, heating element assembled with nichrome wire.

journey.title: Final assembly
journey.detail: Heating element, PCB, handle, and lid assembled onto body and tested.

journey.title: Quality testing
journey.detail: Each kettle tested for leaks, heating performance, and safety shutoff function.

journey.title: Packaging and distribution
journey.detail: Kettles boxed with manuals and shipped to retailers via container freight.
